s5.text:
REAL vs PLACEHOLDER
Real (from our files): centre names, stall counts, straight-line distances, Kim Keat dates, 0.47 vs 0.29 centres per 10k, Choa Chu Kang + Tengah gaps, 18 / 18 / 7 works closures by year, 825,320 seniors.

s6.text:
DEMO SCRIPT (60 s)
1. Real closure, happening now (ribbon).
2. Area average says fine; block level says not (section 2).
3. Map: where seniors are cut off, where diners go.
4. Holds at 10 / 15 / 20 min.
5. Where to put an interim market.
6. Hand-off list for the town council / AAC.
7. Ask Genie one question live.

t4.text: Feature 1: click a centre, it closes, the ripple shows where diners go

s9.text:
WHAT IS REAL HERE
All 123 centres, positions, stall counts and planning areas: NEA + URA files.
R&R dates 2024–26: NEA closure file (43 centres).
Opening years for newer centres: NEA hawker file.

ILLUSTRATIVE
Diner shares use stalls ÷ distance² within 2.5 km. The real version uses walking time from every HDB block.

RENEWAL BOX: R&R history before 2024 is not public. Only centres opened 2014+ or renovated 2024–26 get a real 'years since' number. Everyone else says 'check with NEA'.

t5.text: Features 2+3: which seniors are at risk, and which AACs to tell

s10.text:
WHAT IS REAL HERE
HDB residents, 65+ and 75+ per subzone: SingStat June 2026.
Subzone shapes: URA.
Blocks per subzone: HDB building file (13,436 blocks).
Closures nearby: NEA schedule.

PREVIEW (replace with Sush's access tiers)
'Blocks beyond 15 min' = straight line to nearest NEA centre × 1.3, at 1.0 m/s.

VULNERABILITY = 50% how old the area is (rank of % aged 65+) + 50% share of blocks beyond 15 min. Simple on purpose: easy to explain to judges.

t6.text: Page 2: close a centre, see which seniors lose walkable access. Tiers by age, vulnerability multiplier. No waste, no diner ripples

s11.text:
HOW TO BUILD PAGE 2 IN STREAMLIT
Controls: town, age group (sets walking speed), view (tiers / multiplier).
pydeck PolygonLayer for HDB block footprints, coloured by tier; ScatterplotLayer for centres + 10-min reach rings.

GOLD TABLES
• block_access (block, subzone, nearest_id, walk_m, second_walk_m)
• subzone_seniors (subzone, pct_65p, multiplier)
Tier = walk_m ÷ speed for the chosen age, cut at 10/15/20 min. No routing at click time.

AGE → SPEED (assumed, cite a gait-speed source): under 65 1.3 · 65–74 1.2 · 75–84 1.0 · 85+ 0.8 m/s.
MULTIPLIER = subzone % aged 65+ ÷ HDB average. Score = share of blocks >15 min × multiplier.
